prompt: In this photorealistic photo, a young woman in a denim apron stands center foreground holding a terracotta pot with a blooming red geranium. To her left, an elderly man in a plaid shirt leans on a wooden workbench, pointing at a clipboard held by a teenager in a green t-shirt. On the right, a golden retriever sits patiently next to a stack of empty plastic nursery trays. In the immediate foreground, a rusted metal watering can rests on the wet concrete floor beside a coiled green garden hose. Behind the woman, a tall orchid plant in a white ceramic pot reaches toward the glass ceiling. A small brown tabby cat perches on a shelf in the background left, watching a hanging fern sway slightly. The elderly man’s hand rests gently on the teenager’s shoulder as they discuss the notes. Sunlight streams through the curved glass panels, casting sharp, realistic shadows across the lush foliage and creating lens flares near the top right corner. Dust motes dance in the beams of light, highlighting the humidity in the air. The composition balances the human figures with the vibrant plant life, ensuring every leaf texture and fabric weave is sharply defined against the bright, airy backdrop of the structured greenhouse interior.
